x3.title: Research: what emphasis form drives agent compliance?
x3.imperative: ONE named question: exclamatory/caps vs flat imperative vs consequence-naming vs placement vs markup — what is measured effective, esp. on small models? Brief: crew-handoffs/x3-tone-research.md.
x3.result: Delivered and verified (evidence/x3-tone-research.md). Placement + flat imperative + plain consequence-naming are the measured levers; all-caps/exclamatory is widely practiced but has NO controlled support and is a variance RISK on small models (they are the most format-sensitive, 8-10pt swings). Ranked recommendation + falsifiable prediction for our harness included.
x3.finding: Scoped nulls: no head-to-head caps-vs-flat on agentic multi-step compliance exists; no sonnet-class published study — transfer is inference, testable with our own eval (caps arm vs flat arm).
